test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select ‘No error.’**

He spent a great deal of time / writing on his legal pad and aggressive / underlining whatever he was writing.

options.text: writing on his legal pad and aggressive
He spent a great deal of time

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"writing on his legal pad and aggressive."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
__
 
• The error lies in the part** "aggressive."**
 
• The word** "aggressive"** should be changed to** "aggressively" **to properly modify the action of **underlining**.
 
• **"Aggressively"** is used to modify the verb** "underlining"** to show how he underlined the text, and the sentence flows more smoothly.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

Correct sentence: *He spent a great deal of time **writing on his legal pad and aggressively**__ underlining whatever he was writing.*
